component.name: WindTerm-Weifan
component.summary: Terminal emulator and SSH, SFTP, Telnet and serial client

description.p: A fast, cross-platform terminal emulator with a built-in client for remote sessions, inspired by WindTerm.

ul.li: Local shells with tabs, split panes, search, themes and configurable shortcuts
SSH with agent, key, certificate and security key logins, jump hosts and proxies
Port, agent and X11 forwarding, and an SFTP panel
Session logging, triggers, command completion and input broadcasting
An encrypted credential vault or the system keyring
Sixel and kitty graphics, the kitty keyboard protocol and true colour
